fresh: Newer than every market used so far (after fresh-40c); selected from quality metadata, titles and pre-replay tape validity only, before any replay. Cross-project freshness UNKNOWN.
definition: CG1 = V12g/V58 (original scale, passive 15, STOP290) + decide-conviction gate: DECIDE-side mid at DECIDE < 0.56 -> no new order of any kind until the first FLIP; high-conviction markets, opening, DECIDE timing and post-FLIP unchanged. No clock rule.

gate.pass_if: CG1 vs FULL on scored (non-censored) markets: mean higher AND total return/total cost higher AND mean/std higher AND count <= -100 not higher
gate.report: low (<0.56) vs high groups, median, worst-2/5, mean final cost, mean/p90/max peak capital; settlement labels read only after all replays; censored markets excluded from both arms and not replaced
